Name: FS - Star Wars Armors
Author: chefdaveslambsauce
Description:
[u][b][size=4]Overview[/size][/b][/u]

[list]
[*][size=2]This mod adds 14 Star Wars helmets and 2 Star Wars accessories to the game using the [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿﻿ mod.[/size]
[*][size=2]Many of the helmets are colorable[/size]
[*][size=2]Can be worn by using the [u]hand mirror[/u] provided by the fashion sense mod, which can be added to your inventory at the start of the game, or purchased at Pierre's.[/size]
[/list]
[b][u][size=4]List of Items[/size][/u][/b]

[u][size=3]Helmets:[/size][/u]
[list]
[*][b]Acolyte[/b] (Grayscale)
[*][b]Boba Fett [/b](Colored and Grayscale)
[*][b]Bo Katan[/b] (Colored and Grayscale)
[*][b]Cad Bane[/b] (Colored)
[*][b]Clone Trooper Phase 1[/b] (Grayscale)
[*][b]Clone Trooper Phase 2[/b] (Grayscale)
[*][b]Moff Gideon[/b] (Colored and Grayscale)
[*][b]Kylo Ren[/b] (Colored)
[*][b]Darth Malgus [/b](Colored)
[*][b]The Mandalorian [/b](Grayscale)
[*][b]Darth Revan[/b] (Colored and Grayscale)
[*][b]Stormtrooper [/b](Grayscale)
[*][b]First Order Stormtrooper [/b](Grayscale)
[*][b]Darth Vader[/b] (Colored)
[/list]
[u][size=3]Accessories:[/size][/u]
[list]
[*][b]Darth Malgus' Mask [/b](Colored)
[*][b]Darth Revan's Hood [/b](Colored)
[/list]
[size=4][b][u]Recommended Mods[/u][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]FS - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10837]Traveller's Attire[/url]﻿ by Peaceful End. Adds capes, which is almost a requirement in the star wars universe.[/size]
[/list]
[b][u][size=4]Future Plans[/size][/u][/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]I'll likely add some chest pieces later to go with the helmets.[/size]
[*]I'm looking to add more helmets and make mods for other franchises. Recommendations are welcome.
[/list]
